task1.title: Average snow depth by month at a Canadian ski resort over three years
task1.prompt: The chart below shows the depth of snow (cm) in a particular ski resort in Canada in three years.

chartDesc.title: Average snow depth by month
chartDesc.overview: Across all three years, snow depth was markedly lower from November to January (below 170 cm) before increasing dramatically from February to April, where depths generally exceeded 300 cm.
unreadable: Exact numerical values are not printed above bars and are estimated visually relative to the 50 cm y-axis increments.
keyFeatures: Snow depth jumped significantly between January (115–165 cm) and February (335–450 cm) in all three years.
Year two recorded the highest overall snow depth, reaching approximately 465 cm in April.
Year one peaked in March at around 460 cm before falling to 400 cm in April.
Year three peaked at around 335 cm in both February and March before declining to 285 cm in April.

task1.instruction: Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.
